urllib.request.urlopen() is invoked on an attacker-selected URL without a timeout. An attacker-controlled server can hold connections open and exhaust application workers.
The complete response from an attacker-selected server is read into memory without a size limit. A sufficiently large or endless response can exhaust server memory.
